text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, on the way back to the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pien~~! Hey, listen, listen up-!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mega heart all the girls who aren't in my usual squad too!
But like, I totally can't encounter everyone, ya know!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So like~ I can't even get my random social fix on the spot!
Like, this is a total mental breakdown, right~!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
What's up, what's up~?
If you got worries, I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Uuu... totally that!
For real, you're the best bestie ever~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see~. So there are just too many friends
you wanna hang out with and not enough time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yaaas~! 'Cause I love all my besties to bits!
Chatting with Palmer is super fun too, but—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...There you are.
Helios-san, we're scheduled for tandem training today~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
See—! Now I totally wanna hang out with Nature too~!
This is so painnnn-!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...No, it's not hanging out, it's tandem training.

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ Helios, 'sup~.
I'm going to check out some cheap chic stuff, wanna come~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totes wanna go!? But running with Nature is... 
and chilling with Palmer is also super adorbs...!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I am legit deadlocked! What am I s'posed to do-!?
Hey, hey, heeeey~~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gasp... That's it!?
We can just throw a massive party with everyone!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah... then maybe the dorm kitchen would be good?
Lots of people can fit in, and curfew won't matter.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you a genius!? That's crazy good~~!
It's a pajama party, baby!?

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So totally youth vibes~!
Then I'll bring some Insta-worthy juice~♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The party plan came together in an instant...
Party people are built different... their social skills are insane...

text_block_list.name: Toosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nature-chan, bring your secret stash of dried squid!
It'll look totally aesthetic together, it's a must!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what!? Since when was it decided
that I'm joining too!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aight then, Trainer, you gotta join too-!
Let's get hyped together! Wheeeey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aight then, Trainer, you gotta join too-!
Let's get hyped together! Wheeeey!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wheeeey-whey! 
Riding that good wave, aren't ya☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then Trainer, you're on hype duty with me!
Let's get those vibes up~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Fuji~! We're partying in the dorm!
Plz and thankies☆

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hold on right there.
Trainer-san is strictly forbidden from entering the dorms by academy rules, remember?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It was decided that I would receive photos later instead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Heh... just give up.
Once Helios-san gets going, nothing can stop her.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yeah yeah! Don't underestimate party people☆
choice_data_list: No, seriously, Trainers aren't allowed in the dorms!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAAT!? For real!?
...Then how 'bout putting on my uniform and sneaking in!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, sounds fun, but...
that'll get found out in like two seconds~.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pien! So sadddd!
Then I'll just share all the photos with ya later~~!
